Instantaneous Change.description: Beginning at 5th level, the moon guardian may attempt a Control Shape check as a free action. In addition, this check can be made reactively in response to another creature's action, even outside the moon guardian's own turn. The limitation of only one shape change per round still applies.

Natural Spell.description: Upon reaching 1st level, the moon guardian receives Natural Spell as a bonus feat, provided he does not already possess it.

Rapid Change.description: Starting at 3rd level, the moon guardian may attempt a Control Shape check as a move action instead of a standard action. The restriction of one shape change per round remains in effect.

Spells per Day/Spells Known.description: At each even-numbered moon guardian level, the character gains additional spells per day (and spells known, where applicable) as though he had also advanced one level in whichever divine spellcasting class provided him access to 3rd-level spells prior to entering this prestige class. No other class benefits are gained from this advancement (such as improved turning or rebuking of undead). The moon guardian level stacks with the qualifying divine spellcasting class level for purposes of calculating spells per day, spells known, and caster level. If the character possessed multiple divine spellcasting classes that granted 3rd-level spells before becoming a moon guardian, the player chooses which class benefits from each moon guardian level for spellcasting progression.

Voluntary Change.description: At 1st level, the moon guardian receives a divine blessing from a lunar deity. Unlike typical afflicted lycanthropes, the moon guardian may willingly shift into animal or hybrid form without automatically and permanently adopting the alignment associated with his lycanthropic type. The moon guardian remains vulnerable to involuntary transformation during the full moon and upon taking combat damage, but failing a Control Shape check under those conditions does not alter his alignment. Additionally, if a moon guardian fails a Control Shape check when attempting to return to humanoid form, he may retry the check on each subsequent round rather than having to wait until dawn.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: This prestige class does not grant proficiency with any weapons, armor, or shields.

overrides.description: When an evil lycanthrope transmits the curse of lycanthropy to a victim, the afflicted individual must either seek a swift cure or gradually fall under the savage, malevolent influence of their bestial side. However, good or neutral divine spellcasters who maintain powerful bonds with their patron deities or chosen divine forces can sometimes leverage those spiritual connections to resist the descent into evil. Those who manage this feat become known as moon guardians.
